hypothesis: A verified contradiction or result in the first sentence will improve comparable 72-hour retention without weakening accuracy.
implementation: Each video opens with one research conflict or failed benchmark; no greeting and no generic promise.
visual_policy: Approximately 60–65% observed evidence, validation charts and mechanism diagrams; 35–40% AI narrator.
caution: This is a package-level editorial change, not a clean randomized A/B test. Small samples will not establish causality.
